summary: Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corp, formerly Lottery.com and successor to SPAC Trident Acquisition Corp, filed an 8-K disclosing findings on two connected 2020-2021 "Legacy Transactions" involving former executives of Trident and Lottery.com. The circular scheme used borrowed escrow funds to generate revenue supporting AutoLotto's June 30, 2021 acquisition of Global Gaming Enterprises. Komissarov was sentenced June 24, 2026 to three years in prison; Clemenson and Dickinson pleaded guilty May 22, 2025 and await sentencing. No current officers or directors were involved. This is a historical disclosure, not a new special situation; watch for restatement and litigation risk.
